Her sons Milo and Mikey, Her joy and her brightests suns.

Her life was hard at 20 - 5 (Do math again), She could barely keep a job and her family didn't want to support her "Mistakes" but she wasn't gonna be separated from her children so held her head high and took the pain and uses it to fuel her love for her children.
